title: While payments are in test mode, the member app shows a test payment as paid, but the gym records nothing
what: Payments are in test mode for every gym today, yet any gym that connects Razorpay or Cashfree has the member app pay switch on by default. Members then get test payment pages for their dues and shop orders. A member who finishes one sees Paid, thank you (or Paid. The gym can see it. for a shop order), while no money moved, the gym's Shop page does not show the order as paid and the due stays open at the desk. The join page and the gym web page are kept away from test payments on purpose; the member app is not.
expected: Real members are never shown a test payment page. In test mode the member app shows the UPI QR or says pay at the desk, the same rule as the join page.
who: members of gyms that connected a payment company
how_often: every member payment while payments are in test mode
fix_line: Offer company links in the member app only when payments are live, as the join page does

title: A gym still on its trial can be told the AI Assistant is resting for the month although it has AI credits
what: The AI Assistant counts a gym as paying only when its MettleUp plan is paid. All trial and unpaid gyms share one small monthly spending cap. Once those gyms together reach it, every one of them is told the assistant is resting till next month, even a gym that holds AI credits MettleUp added for it. The credits are taken only after this check, so they sit unused.
expected: A gym with AI credits can use them; the shared trial cap applies only to free use.
who: owners of gyms in their trial
how_often: once the shared monthly cap is used up
fix_line: Skip the shared trial cap for a gym whose credit balance is above zero
